title: UCL AMR resistance target row v1
description: Schema for each row of resistance_targets_v1.csv. CSV blanks are represented as empty strings.

value.description: Unit-interval target value, or blank when no target is assigned.

include_in_score.description: Static v1 eligibility, including potency-informed exclusions materialized from the typed Rust matrix. Run-dependent data filters can still exclude a row.

score_exclusion_reason.description: Semicolon-delimited stable reason codes when include_in_score is false.

source_id.description: Foreign key to resistance_target_sources_v1.csv, or blank when no source/provenance record is assigned.

uncertainty_lower.description: Blank in the legacy v1 baseline unless recoverable uncertainty is later supplied.

uncertainty_upper.description: Blank in the legacy v1 baseline unless recoverable uncertainty is later supplied.

evidence_weight.description: Reserved for a future evidence-quality decision; blank throughout the v1 baseline.

score_row_weight.description: Documents equal static row weighting before component weights.
